items.title: test(gateway): settle managed-worktree reply fixtures
items.summary: test(gateway): settle managed-worktree reply fixtures Fix the existing-worktree sessions.create/sessions.send hourly failure in jobs 114482209021 and 114506381242 (runs 38143525086 and 38151645476). The runtime stub introduced in b7ec596e38a2 skipped lifecycle completion. Its initial reply could finish with recovery custody still on the row; a background display-name write then invalidated the unnecessary orphan recovery during the follow-up send. Linux pressure reproduced the exact SessionRecoverySourceChangedError and traced the title publication. Report the prepared session and run lifecycle, then await the exact run's committed terminal row before returning the mock reply. Keep every existing assertion and the production recovery guards unchanged. Proof on Linux/Node 24.19.0: final file passed 20/20 CPU-pressured runs; reverting only the fix failed immediately with the same error. All three original 25-file/277-test shard replays passed. The single-worker file run passed all 9 cases in 90 seconds (86.70 seconds Vitest). The complete Gateway config ran 510 files/4917 tests: 4913 passed, three unrelated baseline failures, and one existing skip. HTTP failures reproduce on clean a45edbfa69ea and are fixed separately by 2f019cb204c4; the ACP abort-order failure belongs to an unchanged earlier process group. Changed-file oxlint, boundary lint, formatting, architecture and diff checks passed. Test typecheck and check-changed retain the identical seven UI TS2339 baseline errors, verified with the patch removed. Independent P2 review of the final diff was clean.

items.title: perf(sessions): reuse config-owned roster and projection facts (#169263)
items.summary: perf(sessions): reuse config-owned roster and projection facts (#169263) * perf(sessions): reuse config-owned roster and projection facts Retain roster facts for the published config revision and model facts across row-only publications. Let selection and facts publications retire list caches while preserving materialization-scoped weak presentations. Keep independent mutable inputs batch-scoped and invalidate same-object config republication. Exercise configuration refresh through the actual publisher. * fix(sessions): keep roster publication reads import-light Publish config identity and revision before observers through an import-free leaf so roster reads do not introduce a full-graph import cycle. Include the leaf in the extracted maintainer runtime and retire its eligibility on reset. Prove model metadata reuse through updated session-list output and catalog lookup counts instead of asserting empty cache-map identity. * test(gateway): type mutable catalog regression entries * test(gateway): keep catalog regression on API capacity
